name: nestjs-neon-starter
description: Neon Academy backend onboarding starter — NestJS 11 skeleton with the full Neon Apps tooling chain (oxlint, oxfmt, commitlint, husky, type-safety guard scripts) preconfigured. Clone, run, start Day 11.

scripts.lint:check: oxlint src && pnpm lint:no-double-cast && pnpm lint:no-prod-never && pnpm lint:no-untyped-promise && pnpm lint:no-multi-class-dto && pnpm lint:no-unsanctioned-unknown && pnpm lint:no-db-in-service
scripts.lint:no-double-cast: ! grep -rn 'as unknown as' src --include='*.ts' --exclude='*.spec.ts' 2>/dev/null || (echo '✗ Forbidden: as unknown as double-cast in production code. Use proper types or a single cast. Tests may use double-cast for mock typing.' && exit 1)
scripts.lint:no-prod-never: ! grep -rn 'as never' src --include='*.ts' --exclude='*.spec.ts' 2>/dev/null || (echo '✗ Forbidden: as never cast in production code. Use literal union types instead.' && exit 1)
scripts.lint:no-multi-class-dto: for f in $(find src -name '*.dto.ts'); do [ "$(grep -c 'export class' "$f")" -gt 1 ] && { echo "✗ Forbidden: more than one exported class in $f. One DTO per file (SoC)."; exit 1; }; done; true
scripts.lint:no-db-in-service: ! grep -rnaE 'DATABASE_TOKENS|DRIZZLE' src --include='*.service.ts' --exclude='*.spec.ts' 2>/dev/null || (echo '✗ Forbidden: DB token in a *.service.ts. DB access belongs in a repository (SoC).' && exit 1)

src/**/!(*.spec).ts: bash -c '! grep -l "as unknown as" "$@" || (echo "✗ Forbidden as unknown as double-cast in staged production files" && exit 1)' --
bash -c '! grep -l "as never" "$@" || (echo "✗ Forbidden as never cast in staged production files" && exit 1)' --
bash -c 'for f in "$@"; do case "$f" in *.dto.ts) [ "$(grep -c "export class" "$f")" -gt 1 ] && { echo "✗ Multiple exported classes in $f (one DTO per file)"; exit 1; };; esac; done; true' --
src/**/*.service.ts: bash -c '! grep -laE "DATABASE_TOKENS|DRIZZLE" "$@" || (echo "✗ DB token in a staged *.service.ts (DB belongs in a repository, SoC)" && exit 1)' --
